reconcile.note: John Gill reads Psalm 40's denial as comparative, God ordained sacrifice from the beginning yet always prized obedience and mercy above the ceremonial offerings themselves.

sides.snippet: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of the fat of it. Yahweh respected Abel and his offering,
sides.verseText: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of the fat of it. Yahweh respected Abel and his offering,

sides.snippet: Sacrifice and offering you didn't desire. You have opened my ears: Burnt offering and sin offering you have not required.
sides.verseText: Sacrifice and offering you didn't desire. You have opened my ears: Burnt offering and sin offering you have not required.
